quality.deltaInterpretation: At least 1 BB improvement per 20-hand session over published Beginner, two-sided 95% lower bound above 0.05 BB/hand for overall, cash and MTT. No of 40 cell differences may have a two-sided 95% upper bound below -0.10 BB/hand; this is an adoption veto, with no multiplicity claim.

selectionDisclosure: Public heads-up MTT route was chosen after previous frozen evaluation found a severe 2/2-MTT pressure regression. Current correction was selected on exploratory seeds 3830040001 and 3930040001. Neither previous frozen nor exploratory sessions enter this new final evaluation.
limitations: Scripted opponents do not prove human or ICM strength.
Unpaired sessions cannot establish hand-level causal paired EV.
A controller gate pass does not publish the model or prove production routing.
